note: Focus rules whose strongest visible affordance is under 3:1 (WCAG 1.4.11). Read by check:focus-ring. The list is EMPTY on purpose: all 29 findings of the 2026-08-29 sweep were fixed rather than recorded, because an invisible focus ring is a defect and not a preference. A ring on a ground its caller paints is not an exception: its rule declares those grounds with `// @grounds: --color-…` and is measured on each one. An entry here is only for what cannot be measured, and needs a reason a keyboard user can still see where they are.
